macros.name: Gotoh
macros.doc: The command puts the optimal score of the alignment to specified control sequence (default: \GotohScore) after executing the Gotoh algorithm, and returns the alignment results to other control sequences (default: \GotohResultA and \GotohResultB).

macros.name: GotohConfig
macros.doc: You can change various settings and parameters related to this package with \GotohConfig command.
